title: Every positive braid closure other than an unlink has positive-convention signature at least one quarter of its first Betti number plus one half
author: Joshua Evan Greene and Livio Liechti
work: On the signature of a positive braid
source_version: Official published version, Annales Henri Lebesgue 7 (2024), 823-839, 10.5802/ahl.212
difficulty_reason: The complete argument selects four specially patterned chessboard-homology subspaces, proves their Goeritz matrices have trisum structure, develops compensating signature inductions and combines diagram face counts with topology to obtain the quarter-Betti bound. This tailored knot-theoretic construction exceeds qualification topology.
